answer.reason: The verses tell of Machir's descendants conquering Gilead and of Moses giving it to Machir, which the summary does not say.

clauses.english: took Gilead and dispossessed the Amorite who was in it
clauses.quote: went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite

clauses.english: was given Gilead by Moses and dwelt there
clauses.quote: Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein

doubts: NUM 32:39 speaks of the children of Machir taking Gilead, not Machir himself.

Verses on his sons, descendants and later tribal allotments (GEN 50:23, NUM 26:29, NUM 27:1, NUM 36:1, JOS 13:31, JOS 17:3, 1CH 2:21-23, 1CH 7:14-17) were left out as genealogy or already in the summary.
